content:
I suspect there's a bug when trying to derive Countable for a type: the following code that uses the module system doesn't work

module

import Mathlib

inductive Test where
  | test
deriving Inhabited, Countable

Unknown constant `_private.Mathlib.Tactic.DeriveCountable.0.Mathlib.Deriving.Countable.cons_eq_imp_init`

Removing module works as usual.

Disclaimer: I have never used the module system before, so this could be just a case of bad UX rather than a bug.
You need to write import all Mathlib.Tactic.DeriveCountable. I guess because the deriver needs to run some private functions to derive countable
This looks like a bug in the deriver
